description:
Discover Microsoft Playwright MCP, the revolutionary browser automation tool that enables AI agents to interact with websites without screenshots or visual models. In this video, I explain what the Model Context Protocol (MCP) is and how the Playwright MCP works through structured accessibility data, and demonstrate a complete workflow with VS Code in agent mode by opening GitHub, logging in, and starring a repo

Playwright MCP is perfect for web navigation, form filling, data extraction, and AI-assisted browser tasks. It represents the next generation of browser automation that's specifically designed for Large Language Models.

In this video I am using VS Code Insiders. To install I go to the readme and press the vs code insiders button and it adds the server to VS Code with just one click.  

Check out these 2 videos for installation tips:
Install in VS Code: https://youtu.be/cifdyJkKs04
Install in Claude Desktop: https://youtu.be/jQjj3hD0hx4

💻 GitHub Repository: https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-mcp
Check the readme for more info.
